top_signals.title: LVMH Sales in Mainland China Fall by Double Digits
top_signals.summary: LVMH's sales in mainland China dropped by double digits in the third quarter, adding to doubts about the durability of a broader luxury recovery. Bloomberg's Angelina Rascouet reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
